description: Source of truth for every external integration Sasha depends on. Maintained by sasha-ops-hardening. env_vars hold NAMES ONLY (never values). Live keys live in local .env (gitignored) and the VPS .env (/docker/openclaw-h3mk/data/.openclaw/.env).

integrations.name: X Layer RPC
integrations.purpose: OKX X Layer (zkEVM L2) JSON-RPC for reading/writing the Sasha dynamic-fee hook + oracle.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Read-only state fetch retries; signal push uses --force for liveness. Gas estimate with 50% buffer. On CurrencyNotSettled, decode and re-quote.
integrations.notes: Mainnet chainId 196 (0xC4) rpc.xlayer.tech. Testnet chainId 1952 (0x7A0) testrpc.xlayer.tech/terigon (NOT legacy 195). Confirmed vs official OKX docs 2026-06.

integrations.name: Uniswap v4 (PoolManager + Hook + Oracle)
integrations.purpose: Sasha's on-chain risk signal lives in SashaOracle and drives SashaDynamicFeeHook fees on a Uniswap v4 pool on X Layer.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Oracle setFee writes are idempotent; the 2h --force cron keeps updatedAt fresh so the fee never goes stale (<6h fallback).
integrations.notes: PoolManager 0x360e68faccca8ca495c1b759fd9eee466db9fb32. No v4 PositionManager on X Layer.

integrations.name: Allora Network
integrations.purpose: Reputation-weighted decentralized inference (SOL/USD log-return + price-target topics) — Judge #1 in the signal fusion.
integrations.fallback_behavior: On error/timeout, fall back to CoinGecko spot for SOL/USD and mark this judge as degraded (do not zero the fused signal).

integrations.name: Elfa AI
integrations.purpose: Smart-account mention tracking + trending tokens (SOL/MNT/USDC) — Judge #2 in the signal fusion.
integrations.fallback_behavior: On error, mark judge degraded and proceed with remaining sources. Cached endpoints doc in .firecrawl/elfa-endpoints.md.

integrations.name: Polymarket Gamma API
integrations.purpose: Real-money prediction-market odds for risk-off detection (Solana exploit/hack probabilities) — Judge #3.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Public API, no auth. On error, mark judge degraded. NOTE: docs.polymarket.com bot-blocks automated GET (docs-check shows fetch-failed); the page is valid in a browser.

integrations.name: OpenRouter
integrations.purpose: LLM routing for social-bias extraction from Sasha's recent posts in the signal pipeline (model google/gemini-2.5-flash).
integrations.fallback_behavior: Falls back to OPENAI_API_KEY if set; if both absent, social-bias judge is skipped (degraded, not fatal).

integrations.name: Gemini API
integrations.purpose: Reply generation (gemini-2.5-flash) and image generation (gemini-3.x flash image) for Sasha.
integrations.fallback_behavior: On 429/5xx, retry with backoff; reply generation aborts the single reply rather than posting a low-quality fallback.
integrations.notes: Uses GEMINI_API_KEY in scripts (tool-registry previously mislabeled this GOOGLE_API_KEY).

integrations.name: CoinGecko
integrations.purpose: Fallback spot price for SOL/USD and general token price lookups.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Public API; rate-limit (429) backs off. Used only as a fallback price source.

integrations.name: DefiLlama
integrations.purpose: Real-time token prices (coins.llama.fi) and yield-pool scanning (yields.llama.fi) for the LP pool scanner and position marks.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Public API. Price failures cause position-monitor to skip the mark-to-market for that asset rather than emit a bad rebalance signal. Cached docs in .firecrawl/defillama-api-docs.md.

integrations.name: Buffer GraphQL
integrations.purpose: Queue/auto-schedule X posts for Sasha's channel. Persona posts + weekly yield tweet land here.
integrations.fallback_behavior: createPost returns a union (PostActionSuccess | MutationError); read only id/text/message. On 'duplicate', rewrite once then append to state/post-errors.json. NEVER select PostPublishingError.code on the queue-READ query (removed from schema -> HTTP 400).
integrations.notes: Live probe 2026-06-03: endpoint+auth healthy (HTTP 200). Real post failures are from box-level spawnSync ETIMEDOUT, not GraphQL.

integrations.name: X (Twitter) API v2
integrations.purpose: Direct tweet/reply posting (the VPS-side reply path goes through tweet.js).
integrations.fallback_behavior: On 429 stop immediately (no retry) + Telegram alert. On 403 alert with payload. Append posted id to replied-tweets.json on success.
integrations.notes: Reply-path conflict: twitter-reply-gal (VPS) uses this; local morning-reply-run.js uses ADB. See sasha-social-agent/references/reply-paths.md.

integrations.name: Apify
integrations.purpose: Scrape recent tweets from the KOL shortlist + keyword search for reply candidates.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Key rotation via apify-rotate.js on quota/429. On total failure, reply run skips (no candidates) rather than erroring the engine.

integrations.name: ADB (Android Debug Bridge)
integrations.purpose: Native reply posting via a physical phone running the X app (no API cost). LOCAL-ONLY path (cannot run on the VPS).
integrations.fallback_behavior: 3 ADB reconnect retries; optimistic pre-write of tweet id to replied-tweets.json before the post so a kill mid-post still dedupes. Returns ok|unconfirmed|subscribers_only|error.

integrations.name: Typefully
integrations.purpose: Draft/thread management for Sasha (MCP). Currently non-blocking; future scheduled posting.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Not on the autonomous path. Manual/assisted use only.

integrations.name: Byreal CLI
integrations.purpose: Solana CLMM DEX: pool query, position open/close/claim, token swap, auto-compound.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Solana keypair stored host-side (~/.config/byreal/keys/id.json). --base must be a held pool mint; size in base-token units; --slippage 200; --auto-swap. Dry-run default.
integrations.notes: byreal-cli + keys run on the HOST as root (cron /etc/cron.d/sasha-trade), not inside the container.

integrations.name: Hyperliquid
integrations.purpose: Delta-neutral perp short to hedge the volatile leg of LP positions; funding-rate kill switch.
integrations.fallback_behavior: HEDGE_LIVE_OK=1 gates live orders to the sasha-hedge cron only. Rehedge >5% drift. Funding kill switch < -54.75% annualized. Min order value $10 (orders below are skipped).
integrations.notes: EIP-712 signing chainId 1337. Funding via Arbitrum USDC bridge.

integrations.name: LiFi
integrations.purpose: Cross-chain bridge quotes (Solana -> Mantle) for sourcing MNT liquidity / mETH compounding.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Quote-only (read). Actual bridge execution is a separate gated, confirmation-required step. API key optional (rate-limit boost).

integrations.name: Clawlett wallet (Gnosis Safe + Zodiac Roles + CoW + KyberSwap + CNS)
integrations.purpose: Multi-sig custody + permissioned execution for on-chain trading on Base/BNB; MEV-protected swaps; Trenches token actions.
integrations.fallback_behavior: ALL on-chain execution requires explicit Gabriel confirmation per Clawlett SKILL.md policy. Owner config in Clawlett/config/base/wallet.json (VPS-only, never committed).
integrations.notes: AgentKeyFactoryV3 0x2EA0010c..., KyberSwap 0x6131B5..., CoW Settlement 0x9008D1..., ZodiacHelpers 0x38441B..., CNS 0x299319e0....

integrations.name: Mantle RPC + ERC-8004 identity + mETH treasury
integrations.purpose: On-chain reads/writes on Mantle: ERC-8004 agent identity + attestation, mETH staking/yield treasury.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Identity Registry at 0x8004...; self-transfer attestation after LP actions. mETH stake() is MAINNET-only (buy mETH on a Mantle DEX via LiFi on L2).

integrations.name: Base RPC
integrations.purpose: Base mainnet reads: token balances, Aerodrome Slipstream LP state, Gnosis Safe reads.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Multiple RPC fallbacks (publicnode, llamarpc, Alchemy). Read-only position snapshots.

integrations.name: Solana RPC
integrations.purpose: Byreal position reads + wallet balance checks.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Read-only. Balance fetches shell out to byreal-cli; under box load these can hit spawnSync ETIMEDOUT (see sasha-ops-hardening).

integrations.name: Arbitrum RPC
integrations.purpose: USDC bridge funding path into Hyperliquid (Bridge2).
integrations.fallback_behavior: Deposit-only, gated. Public RPC with fallbacks.

integrations.name: Trenches API
integrations.purpose: $SASHA token price + trending tokens on the Trenches launch platform.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Read-only price/pump tracking.
integrations.notes: docs_url unverified — confirm canonical Trenches developer docs.

integrations.name: Telegram Bot API
integrations.purpose: Primary Gabriel <-> Sasha channel + all script alert notifications + the phone command bridge.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Fire-and-forget; send errors swallowed so alerting never blocks the pipeline. Falls back TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN/CHAT_ID if bridge vars absent.

integrations.name: Dune + Sim
integrations.purpose: On-chain analytics dashboards/queries for Sasha's wallet + positions.
integrations.fallback_behavior: REST API creates auto-archived queries; MCP locked to manga82 account. Read-only analytics.
integrations.notes: Use agent EOA 0xba3BB32 as FROM address for queries, not the Safe.

integrations.name: ElevenLabs
integrations.purpose: Voice synthesis for podcast/video samples (canonical voice 'Jessica').
integrations.fallback_behavior: Content-side utility. Voice id cgSgspJ2msm6clMCkdW9.
integrations.notes: Content production belongs in the marketing workspace; this is a dev utility.

integrations.name: Google OAuth (Workspace)
integrations.purpose: OAuth token generation for Google Workspace integrations (docs/sheets) — infra only, not on the autonomous path.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Currently unused by runtime scripts.
integrations.notes: Docs API (docs.googleapis.com) is disabled project-wide; use Drive HTML import path for any doc output.

integrations.name: GitHub API
integrations.purpose: Repo access / release tracking (not on the autonomous posting path).
integrations.fallback_behavior: Not automated. Manual/CI use.

integrations.name: Firecrawl
integrations.purpose: Scrape protocol docs / yield data / hackathon info for research; caches to .firecrawl/.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Research-only. Outputs cached as markdown.

integrations.name: ScreenshotOne
integrations.purpose: Above-the-fold screenshots of web pages for visual intelligence / assets.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Research/asset utility.

integrations.name: YepAPI
integrations.purpose: Search API utility (research).
integrations.fallback_behavior: Research-only; not on the autonomous path.
integrations.notes: docs_url unverified — confirm canonical YepAPI developer docs or mark deprecated if unused.

integrations.name: HasData
integrations.purpose: Web data / SERP extraction utility (research).
integrations.fallback_behavior: Research-only; not referenced by runtime scripts. Candidate for removal if unused.

integrations.name: Supabase content MCP (mangabeira-content)
integrations.purpose: Push/publish content to mangabeira.net. CROSS-WORKSPACE — owned by the marketing workspace, listed here for completeness.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Not part of Sasha's runtime. Draft-first, publish on explicit approval.

integrations.name: The Graph
integrations.purpose: CL subgraph data for the LP pool scanner: tick-level in-range liquidity + exact per-pool daily/hourly history (volumeUSD/feesUSD/tvlUSD) on Base/Ethereum. The realized-fee-APR + concentration source the aggregators are built on.
integrations.fallback_behavior: Authed (Bearer key, 32 hex). Free tier 100k queries/mo. If key absent or gateway down, the verifier marks The Graph degraded (not drift) and the scanner falls back to GeckoTerminal/DexScreener + on-chain. EVM-only in practice (no usable Solana CLMM subgraph). feesUSD is derived (volume x feeTier), not realized.
integrations.notes: Verified subgraphs: Uniswap v3 ETH 5zvR82QoaXYFyDEKLZ9t6v9adgnptxYpKpSbxtgVENFV, Aerodrome Base GENunSHWLBXm59mBSgPzQ8metBEp9YDfdqwFr91Av1UM. Stored key arrived 151 chars (junk-suffixed); verifier trims to first 32 hex. Authed, so only the LOCAL verifier checks it, not the cloud routine. Spec: docs/integrations/lp-data-sources-api-reference.md section 5.
